mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 71 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School, and we are currently seeing a first quarter moon phase.

The City of Verona is working on several major projects, including the Mark Drive reconstruction which is in its second phase, and ongoing pavement rehabilitation efforts across the city to keep our streets safe and functional.

We have a busy schedule for the next couple of days. Today, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, or pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the free concert at Century School Park or trivia night at Hop Haus.

Regarding the weekly report, on Friday, August 15, officers responded to an incident where a 44-year-old driver was found unresponsive behind the wheel; she was subsequently arrested for a first offence O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the refreshing Double Strawberry. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
